DcQAGhCtBa4.text: dr._carlos_vergara Original audio Follow dr._carlos_vergara 14w When the truth comes from the patient AND the surgeon… you believe the process. ❤️ A facelift is not an overnight transformation. It’s a process. From a patient’s perspective, recovery can bring swelling, bruising, tightness, uncertainty—and moments when you may wonder, “Is this normal?” But this is where trust matters. Trust your surgeon. Trust the plan. Trust your body. And most importantly, trust the healing process. A modern facelift is designed to restore and reposition tissues—not to make you look like someone else. The final result takes time to reveal itself. My patient’s experience is a reminder: don’t judge your facelift by Day 3, Day 7, or even Day 14. Your face is healing, evolving, and becoming more natural every day. ✨ The best results are not rushed. ✨ Recovery is part of the transformation. ✨ And honesty throughout the process matters. DZNZmGXFCeJ.text: newskinbellevue drbrianscott and newskinbellevue Bellevue, Washington drbrianscott 24w This patient in her mid 40s wanted to address early aging signs that she felt made her look more tired and aged than she felt inside. We performed a deep plane face and neck lift which addressed her neck banding, jawline and jowl laxity, and softened her smile lines (nasolabial folds). I contoured all of the deep structures in her neck to give her excellent jawline definition all the way back to the angle (back corner) of the jaw On her left side view if you look closely you can see a mole that started out on her cheek that ended up getting lifted up and back almost to the top of her ear. This is a fun example of how much lifting can be achieved even in a fairly young patient. We also performed a lower eyelid surgery to reduce the lower eyelid puffiness and performed a small amount of fat grafting under her eyes to improve hollowness. She is now 3 months out from surgery and you can see she still looks exactly like herself just more rejuvenated and vibrant appearing.
